name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by his grandfather's tales of rallying in the Norwegian mountains. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, focusing on vehicle dynamics and aerodynamics. While still a student, he interned with a small racing team, where he quickly proved his aptitude for problem-solving and data analysis. Now, he's eager to apply his theoretical knowledge and hands-on experience to a competitive team, pushing the boundaries of performance through meticulous engineering and innovative solutions.

Bjørn approaches his role with a data-driven mindset, believing that every aspect of the car can be optimized through careful measurement and analysis. He is meticulous in his planning and execution, always striving for perfection. While still developing his leadership skills, his enthusiasm and dedication are contagious, inspiring those around him to strive for excellence. He sees the technical director role as a crucial bridge between design, engineering, and on-track performance, and is determined to make a significant impact.

Bjørn is not afraid to challenge conventional thinking and is always seeking new ways to improve performance. His innovative ideas, combined with his relentless work ethic, makes him a highly promising technical director, ready to make a name for himself in the world of motorsport.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly parted with a slight wave
physical.description: Bjørn is a young man of average height with a focused gaze.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen to jot down ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his fingers when concentrating.
Insists on using metric measurements exclusively.
